train.session_description: Data from monkey Haydn performing ready-set-go time interval reproduction task. This file contains continuous segments of the full session on 2016-12-11 that can be used for training models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.
train.general/experiment_description: Cognitive timing task in which subject attempts to reproduce interval between two cues

test.session_description: Data from monkey Haydn performing ready-set-go time interval reproduction task. This file contains segments of trials from the full session on 2016-12-11 that are to be used for evaluating models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.
test.general/experiment_description: Cognitive timing task in which subject attempts to reproduce interval between two cues
